image_description: A colorful minibus (likely a Ford Transit based model) parked on a paved surface. The vehicle features a two-tone paint job with a red roof and upper section, and a lime green lower body separated by a yellow stripe. It has a black front grille, a large windshield with wipers, side mirrors, and visible wheels. There is text on the windshield and a license plate on the front bumper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic van-derived boxy silhouette of a minibus, distinct from larger transit buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, along with side windows for the driver and passenger area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a minibus. A sliding door track/handle is visible on the side, indicating the entrance location.
The panel gap and handle on the side indicate a sliding door mechanism typical of this vehicle class.
The short hood/bonnet area in front of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame of the image.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a distinct multi-colored livery (red/green/yellow) which fits the description of company/route markings.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible front wheel matches the size and style of a standard commercial van.
The overall scale and window configuration are consistent with a 4-10 passenger capacity vehicle.

artifact_observations.location: Windshield destination sign and front license plate
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the windshield destination board is illegible gibberish. The license plate characters are distorted and do not form a valid alphanumeric sequence, a common AI artifact.

artifact_observations.location: Side mirror and door handle area
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and lack of sharp mechanical definition in the side mirror housing and door handle compared to the rest of the bodywork.
The emblem on the front grille is melted and indistinct, lacking the crisp geometry of a real manufacturer logo.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific make/model classification and ensure it aligns with the 'minibus' taxonomy.

To check for edge bleeding between the complex colored stripes and the background, and verify panel continuity.

Sharpness of body lines and panel gaps

Also, verify if the 'melting' of the grille emblem is a texture issue or a structural topology failure.
